 U.S. news Costco-brand whipped cream recalled over potential presence of cleaning chemical
 Alamance Foods, the product’s manufacturer, said no serious effects requiring medical care were reported to the company. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 The whipped cream was sold in 12 states. Gary Hershorn / Getty Images Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 14, 2026, 4:21 PM EST By Doha Madani Costco members who love a whipped topping may consider going à la mode with their favorite dessert instead after the retailer’s Kirkland-brand whipped cream was recalled.

 Slide 1 of 1 Cans of Kirkland Signature Real Heavy Whipped Cream sold between Oct. 11 and Oct. 31 are subject to a voluntary recall after some customers reported a chemical taste and smell. Alamance Foods, the manufacturer, said it has received no reports of serious effects requiring medical care.
 “We have learned that one batch of Kirkland Signature Whipped Cream may contain a small amount of a cleaning chemical,” the company said.
